name: Mind x 2
source:
Main character is a devil who is expelled from school and exiled to the human world to wander in sorrow. His classmate invents a computer program that programs protagonist to forget about his extraterrestrial origin. That makes protagonist start insult spree at this school of high tech and sorcery.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个被学校开除并流放到人间悲伤徘徊的恶魔。他的同学发明了一种计算机程序，可以让主角忘记自己的外​​星起源。这使得主角开始对这所高科技和魔法学校进行侮辱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
